summary: Ahrens voted Aye on AB 715, creating an antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight in California schools, and co-authored AB 1468, a failed proposal to center high-school ethnic studies on domestic experiences. CAIR Action lists him as preferred and Vote for Peace rates him Ally in the general, assessments that sit in tension with his legislative record on education and classroom content.
